title: Combination of a Big Data Analytics Resource System With an Artificial Intelligence Algorithm to Identify Clinically Actionable Radiation Dose Thresholds for Dysphagia in Head and Neck Patients.
summary: The full article reports an exploratory learned-ranking analysis of 132 head-and-neck radiotherapy patients, relating dose-volume measures to grade ≥2 dysphagia; specific dose thresholds are proposed from this selected cohort. These are exploratory associations and not independent or causal validation.
